description: Pill R-2 captured evidence, supplied to the v0.3.1->v0.4.0 migration so that real evidence replaces legacy placeholders. Anything not covered here stays legacy or stays an owner blocker.

namingRules.note: Semantic layer: the row name encodes the component-set identity the row documents. Unique within its parent content block (4 rows, 4 distinct names, verified).
Semantic layer: size_row / style_row / accent_row / icon_row. Unique within its parent content block (verified).
Structural wrapper. Both Pill theme containers are literally named 'card'; identity comes from containerNodeId, never the name.

Structural wrapper. TWO content siblings exist per card (the list strip and the matrix). Parent-scoped uniqueness is demonstrably false for this role; the resolver disambiguates by layoutRepresentationRef + rootNodeId.
Structural wrapper, 3 occurrences at two depths.
Structural wrapper; also used for the build holder NODE-0545.
Incidental layer, 12 occurrences, all siblings. Recorded, never enforced; the resolver performs no uniqueness enforcement for observed_only roles.

evidence.note: Per-axis list strip: four rows, one axis each (Size, Style, Accent, Icon), 15 Pill instances per theme card. This block and the matrix block below coexist in every card -- the v0.3.1 scalar layoutStrategy could not say so.

Rows are COMPONENT_SET identity, recomputed from 64 instances' ownership and absoluteY ordering; columns are Accent by absoluteX; bands are Size {Regular, Small}; Icon is fixed at None across all 64. Dark and Light were derived independently and agree.

explicitVariableModes is empty on this node AND on every ancestor up to and including PAGE NODE-0538. NODE-0299 is the colors collection defaultModeId, so the Dark resolution is a pure default-inheritance, not a declared choice.
explicitVariableModes on this node declares the colors collection -> mode NODE-0558 (Light). No ancestor sets it.
